description.value: The Eagle's Nest Pub is a full-service waterfront pub on the second floor of the marina building at Island West Resort, with sweeping views over Ucluelet Harbour and the working fishing dock below. With over 100 seats plus a patio, it serves scratch soups, salads, and hand-cut-fry burgers alongside pool tables and big-screen TVs. It sits at the centre of the resort complex, walkable to the campground, motel, and Ucluelet town centre—making it a natural end-of-ride stop for cyclists touring the Pacific Rim.
